elements.element: Customer has no minimum purchase or volume commitment.
elements.evidence: Client remains subject to minimum monthly fees for Hosting Services and Support Services during the current 12-month term.

elements.element: Customer pays only for usage or ordered Services.
elements.evidence: Although fees apply to requested or utilized services, the clause expressly retains minimum monthly fees regardless of actual usage or orders.

elements.element: The commitment is limited to the current 12-month term.
elements.evidence: The added operative sentence states that the minimum monthly fees apply only during the current 12-month term.

elements.element: Customer may reduce the commitment on 30 days' notice.
elements.evidence: The added sentence permits Client, the Customer party, to reduce the minimums upon 30 days' written notice.

elements.element: Any shortfall is handled through a true-up rather than a penalty.
elements.evidence: The added sentence expressly provides that any shortfall will be trued up rather than charged as a penalty.
